description: This file defines runtime configuration management for a web application, including loading defaults, validating config data at runtime with schemas, and fetching configuration data from a server endpoint (/config.json). It exposes functions to retrieve build-time defaults and load runtime configurations, incorporating environment variables and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: getBuildTimeDefaults()
methods.description: Returns default configuration values based on environment variables and fallback defaults for app version, API base URL, WebSocket URL, feature flags, and dashboard exposure.

methods.name: loadRuntimeConfig()
methods.description: Fetches the configuration JSON from /config.json, validates and merges it with build defaults, and handles errors or malformed data by reverting to defaults.
